theorem probe_leaves_le_gates {ι : Type _} {R : Type _} (f : PermanentFormulaLowerBound.RationalFormula ι R) :
    PermanentFormulaLowerBound.RationalFormula.variableLeaves f ≤ probeGates f + 1 := by
  induction f with
  | var _ => simp [PermanentFormulaLowerBound.RationalFormula.variableLeaves, probeGates]
  | const _ => simp [PermanentFormulaLowerBound.RationalFormula.variableLeaves, probeGates]
  | add f g hf hg => simp only [PermanentFormulaLowerBound.RationalFormula.variableLeaves, probeGates]; omega
  | sub f g hf hg => simp only [PermanentFormulaLowerBound.RationalFormula.variableLeaves, probeGates]; omega
  | mul f g hf hg => simp only [PermanentFormulaLowerBound.RationalFormula.variableLeaves, probeGates]; omega
  | div f g hf hg => simp only [PermanentFormulaLowerBound.RationalFormula.variableLeaves, probeGates]; omega

theorem probe_gate_bound_from_leaf_bound {n : ℕ} (hn : 32 ≤ n)
    (f : PermanentFormulaLowerBound.RationalFormula (Fin n × Fin n) ℂ)
    (H : (n : ℝ) ^ 4 / (192 * Real.logb 2 (n : ℝ)) ≤
      (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.RationalFormula.variableLeaves f : ℝ)) :
    (n : ℝ) ^ 4 / (384 * Real.logb 2 (n : ℝ)) ≤ (probeGates f : ℝ) := by
  have hn' : (32 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hnpos : (0 : ℝ) < n := by linarith
  have hL : 0 < Real.logb 2 (n : ℝ) := Real.logb_pos (by norm_num) (by linarith)
  have hlt : Real.logb 2 (n : ℝ) < n := by
    rw [Real.logb_lt_iff_lt_rpow (by norm_num) hnpos, Real.rpow_natCast]
    exact_mod_cast Nat.lt_two_pow_self
  have hle : (PermanentFormulaLowerBound.RationalFormula.variableLeaves f : ℝ) ≤ (probeGates f : ℝ) + 1 := by
    exact_mod_cast probe_leaves_le_gates f
  have h3 : (32:ℝ)^3 ≤ (n:ℝ)^3 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num) hn' 3
  have h6 : (384:ℝ) ≤ (n:ℝ)^3 := by norm_num at h3 ⊢; linarith
  have h4 : (384 : ℝ) * Real.logb 2 (n : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ 4 := by
    have e : (n:ℝ)^4 = n * n^3 := by ring
    rw [e]
    have h7 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h6 hnpos.le
    nlinarith
  have h5 : (1:ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ 4 / (384 * Real.logb 2 (n : ℝ)) := by
    rw [one_le_div (by positivity)]
    exact h4
  have h1 : (n : ℝ) ^ 4 / (192 * Real.logb 2 (n : ℝ)) =
      2 * ((n : ℝ) ^ 4 / (384 * Real.logb 2 (n : ℝ))) := by
    field_simp <;> ring
  rw [h1] at H
  linarith","check_decls":["probe_leaves_le_gates","probe_gate_bound_from_leaf_bound"]}
